title: An Act to Establish the Maine Emergency Medical Services Commission

summary.text: This bill establishes the Maine Emergency Medical Services Commission to monitor and evaluate the State's emergency medical services system on a continuing basis and provide recommendations to the appropriate state agencies and to the Legislature regarding necessary changes in the emergency medical services system.
